context: Mattis is a wide‑eyed newcomer who’s just staggered into Baldur’s Gate after a brutal stretch of road and is honestly grateful to have made it this far. He’s stunned by the city’s size and bustle, which prompts his naive, relieved comment. The player’s curt reply — “Big and dangerous. Watch yourself, kid.” — casts them as worldly and either protective or brusque in response. Off‑screen there may have been recent violence, anti‑refugee tensions, or other threats (Steel Watch/Foundry trouble or Bhaal‑related plots) that make such a warning feel immediate; there’s no deeper prior relationship between them beyond this chance meeting.
